observation.visible_scene: A low-light close-up. The excerpt opens on a lit match: a tall, flickering white-yellow flame with a blue base sits on the match head, the wooden stick angled from center toward the lower-right against a black background. After the flame fades, the view becomes a matchbox with a maroon/red central band and white edges carrying small printed text, held at a diagonal on the left side of the frame, with an unlit match (red head on a pale stick) brought in from the right and held against the box's side.
visible_changes: The burning flame repeatedly elongates and shortens (curved in some frames, pointed in others), then the whole image dims to near-total black for several frames.
A matchbox edge appears blurred at the lower-left, then grows larger and sharper, occupying the left/center; its tilt shifts slightly as it settles.
Printed text on the box becomes legible over time (e.g., 'Royal Oak Enterprises, LLC Roswell, GA 30076 USA', 'for over 135 years', 'Special handling may apply in California').
An unlit match with a red head enters from the right and moves to rest against the lower side of the box, remaining there without any visible flame through the last frame.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the black interval is a continuous camera move or an editing cut.
Whether the initially burning match and the later unlit match are the same object.
What caused the flame to vanish and the scene to darken.
The outcome of holding the match head to the box side (striking/ignition is not shown).
uncertain_details: The exact mechanism of the dark transition (cut vs motion) is indeterminate.
Whether the red match head is in true contact with a striker surface or merely adjacent.
Whether the box's changing orientation is due to an off-screen hand or camera movement.
